ImDecayProfile.description:
Deterministic decay applied to today's SIMM IM to approximate `E[IM(t)]`.

`IM(t) = IM(0) × factor(t)`. This is the standard first-order practitioner
approximation for MVA (Green 2015, ch. 10): IM shrinks as the portfolio's
remaining risk runs off.

# Variants

| Variant | `factor(t)` | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| `Constant` | `1` | Evergreen / constantly re-hedged books |
| `LinearToMaturity` | `max(1 − t/T, 0)` | Amortizing linear-risk books |
| `SqrtTime` | `sqrt(max(1 − t/T, 0))` | DV01-style risk ∝ √(remaining time) |

oneOf.description: IM stays at today's level for the whole horizon.
IM decays linearly to zero at `maturity_years`.

maturity_years.description: Portfolio maturity `T` in years (must be positive and finite).

oneOf.description: IM decays like the square root of remaining time to `maturity_years`.

maturity_years.description: Portfolio maturity `T` in years (must be positive and finite).

ImProfile.description: Complete dated expected posted initial margin in one currency and netting set.

basis.description: Legal scope, source and election for the expected IM.

currency.description: Currency of the opening and every projected amount.

dates.description: Calendar observations starting with the valuation date and ending at the horizon.

im_values.description: Expected posted IM in major units of the calculation currency, nonnegative.

ImProjectionBasis.description: Source of the expected posted initial margin on a dated grid.

oneOf.description: Qualified expected posted IM from a supplied risk calculation.

netting_set.description: Legal portfolio scope measured by the supplied calculation.

source_id.description: Permanent identifier of the supplied evidence and methodology.

oneOf.description: Deterministic runoff from a single dated, historical SIMM calculation.

decay.description: Elected deterministic approximation applied to the opening margin.

netting_set.description: Legal portfolio scope supplying the opening margin.

source_id.description: Fingerprint of the admitted inputs, calculation and projection.

MarginFundingSpread.description: Funding-spread election in basis points for a dated IM profile.

oneOf.description: Apply one finite nonnegative spread at all dates.

spread_bp.description: Spread in basis points (for example 25 represents 0.25%).

oneOf.description: Linear interpolation of nonnegative basis-point spreads across a complete dated interval.

knots.description:
Calendar dates and spread quotes in basis points. The dates must
cover the open and close of the admitted IM horizon.

NettingSetId.description:
Identifies a margin netting set.

Instruments in the same netting set can offset each other for margin
calculation purposes. The netting set is typically defined by the
CSA agreement (bilateral) or by CCP membership (cleared) — these two
shapes are mutually exclusive, so the type encodes them as enum
variants rather than as a struct with two `Option<String>` fields
that could in principle both be set or both be unset.

oneOf.description: A bilateral netting set scoped by counterparty + CSA.
A cleared netting set scoped by CCP membership.

ccp_id.description: CCP identifier (also used as the counterparty id)

description: Funding cost/benefit configuration for FVA and MVA calculation.

funding_benefit_bp.description:
Funding benefit spread in basis points (benefit on negative exposure).

If `None`, symmetric funding is assumed: `funding_benefit = funding_spread`.
In practice, the benefit spread may be lower than the cost spread
due to asymmetric funding conditions.

funding_spread_bp.description:
Funding spread in basis points (cost on positive exposure).

This is the spread over the risk-free rate that the institution
pays to fund positive (out-of-the-money to counterparty) exposure.
Typical values: 20–100 bp depending on the institution's credit quality.

im_profile.description:
Expected initial-margin profile `E[IM(t)]` that drives MVA.

When `Some`, [`crate::xva::cva::compute_bilateral_xva`] prices the
lifetime funding cost of posting this IM and reports it as
[`XvaResult::mva`]. When `None`, MVA is not computed and
[`XvaResult::mva`] is `None`.

Build the profile with
[`crate::xva::mva::im_profile_from_simm`] (deterministic SIMM decay), or
supply the path-consistent mean IM from your own simulation.

margin_funding_spread.description:
Explicit, separately elected funding spread for posted IM.
Supply it together with the IM profile to enable MVA.
